name: Instant Complete Retry
description: Skips the level-complete screen and automatically retries after a customizable delay.

instant-retry-after-complete.name: Instant Retry After Complete
instant-retry-after-complete.description: When enabled, a completed level is saved normally, the Level Complete screen is hidden, and the level automatically restarts.

restart-delay-seconds.name: Restart Delay (seconds)
restart-delay-seconds.description: How long to wait after beating the level before automatically restarting it.
